title: Subset Selection Based On Multiple Rankings in the Presence of Bias: Effectiveness of Fairness Constraints for Multiwinner Voting Score Functions
reasoning: The paper focuses on algorithmic fairness and bias mitigation within subset selection and social choice theory. While it discusses fairness as a mathematical constraint to correct for group bias (e.g., race or gender), it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or specific ethical frameworks beyond algorithmic performance metrics.
